newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE shares jump after damages news.
newsitem.headline: RWE shares jump after damages news.

text.p: Shares in German utility RWE AG jumped on Thursday after a German federal court ruled that the company was entitled to partial damages from the state over delays in operating a nuclear power plant.

The shares advanced on the news to hit a high of 70 marks before easing back to trade up 80 pfennigs, or 1.2 percent, at 69.20 marks at 1136 GMT while the DAX index was up 4.55 points at 2,993.00 points.
RWE has demanded seven billion marks in damages for its initial investments, lost profit and cost of maintaining the nuclear plant site.
